answer_1.quote: As a speaker (generation), the model computes a probability distribution P_s (u|I, t; θ) over descriptions u of the target t ∈ {1, ..., N } in the given context I.

answer_2.quote: We use MAUVE, a reference-less generation evaluation metric, to evaluate the similarity of each model's language to human language.

answer_4.quote: We deploy our systems to interact with human workers on MTurk, at a total cost of $12,980USD.
